jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Lazer is a world-class digital product studio composed of 180+ senior engineers and designers with backgrounds from companies like Apple, Google, Coinbase, and more. With our product experience, we have designed, engineered, and grown products from $0 to $200M in revenue.

Clients seek out our help because we have the talent to deeply understand their needs and provide industry, technical, or product insights that are uniquely valuable to their efforts. Our clients range from early-stage startups and venture studios to recognizable retail brands and exciting enterprises. Some of our notable clients include Google, Shopify, Coinbase, Alchemy, Hinge, OVO, Polymarket, and more.

We are a remote-first organization headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, with employees worldwide. We believe in providing the best experience possible for all Lazerites by fostering a strong community through regular events, company vacations, competitive compensation, unlimited PTO, and more!

Join Lazer and help us solve problems and build the next generation of products!

Lazer Core is a specialized team within Lazer focused on building robust, AI-powered full-stack applications. We partner closely with ambitious teams across industries to bring cutting-edge products to life, leveraging the latest in AI, agentic workflows, and scalable infrastructure. Our engineers work across the stack, helping clients solve high-impact problems with tailored, production-ready solutions.

Who You Are:

  • 4–6 years of experience as a Full Stack Engineer working with TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python or Go.

  • Experience with generative AI in areas like image or video generation.

  • Proven experience shipping production software across the stack.

  • Strong experience hosting, tuning, and managing LLM services, libraries, or tools.

  • Experience working with agentic workflows, including creating and using MCP servers.

  • A track record of building AI-powered features such as information extraction, chatbots, document construction, search, data normalization, etc.

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering and structured experimentation workflows.

  • Experience fine-tuning LLMs using open-source models or closed-source services.

  • Confidence in setting up testing infrastructure around agentic applications.

  • Comfort working with at least one major cloud provider (GCP, AWS, Azure), especially data tools like BigQuery, SageMaker, etc.

  • Previous experience in consulting or contracting roles, with the ability to manage client expectations and timelines.

What You'll Do:

  • Engage with clients to understand their problems, needs, goals, and technical environments.

  • Architect, build, and ship full stack applications that leverage AI and data capabilities.

  • Apply best practices in MLOps or LLMOps, including testing, monitoring, and reliability.

  • Design and build scalable data pipelines and data lakes as needed.

  • Communicate tradeoffs and risks transparently, supporting client decision-making.

  • Collaborate with other engineers and cross-functional teams to deliver impactful results.

  • Stay current with the latest AI trends, technologies, and tooling to bring innovation to your projects.

Nice to Have:

The following would be a bonus experience to have, though highlight any additional experience or skills you may have. We like working with people with varied backgrounds and experiences.

  • Experience with generative AI in areas like image or video generation.

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration.

  • Background using ETL frameworks (e.g., Airflow).

  • Skills in mobile development (e.g., React Native, native iOS/Android).

  • Strong design sensibility and user experience intuition.

  • Solid statistics or data science background for intelligent data analysis.

  • Relevant certifications, open-source contributions, or technical publications.

AI in our hiring process
We use AI to help us review and shortlist applications based on job-related criteria. A human hiring manager always makes the call on who moves forward. As a company that builds with AI every day, we're all for candidates using it too — just be upfront about how it helped.

Why Work With Us

  • 🚀 Accelerate Your Growth: Work across multiple industries and cutting-edge projects with a team that ships fast.

  • 💥 Maximum Impact: Shape the future of the tech industry by helping ambitious projects reach their potential.

  • 🏅 True Ownership: Everyone ships code and has real autonomy with minimal meetings.

  • 💡 Continuous Learning: Be part of a team of senior engineers and designers who love learning and knowledge sharing.

Why This Might Not Be For You

  • 🤖 You Resist Modern Tools: We leverage AI and cutting-edge technology to build rapidly and focus our energy on solving the most complex, high-impact challenges for our clients.

  • 🏗️ You Crave High Structure: We thrive in an autonomous, fast-moving environment, which means you need to be comfortable with some ambiguity.

  • 😴 You Prefer Conventional Careers: Our consulting approach involves varied projects and direct client interaction — it's not for everyone.

  • 1️⃣ You Like Staying in One Lane: Our projects require adapting to different tech stacks and modern tooling quickly.

Benefits & Perks

  • 🌐 Work From Anywhere: Choose your workspace — all you need is strong wifi and a passion for building!

  • 🧘‍♂️ Work / Life Balance: We believe in our team’s ability to have it all; a great career, and time to unplug and live…you know...life.

  • 🩺 Employee Care: We provide full benefits (healthcare, dental, vision) for our employees (401k for our US employees)

  • 🏖️ Unlimited PTO: Everyone needs a break. Take at least 15 days off a year, and more if you need—just be cool about it and keep the team in mind.

  • 🎉 Regular Team Retreat: Join us for a week of team bonding at amazing destinations. Recent trips include the Dominican Republic, Cancun, and Hawaii — plus ones welcome.

Lazer Commerce is a specialized team within Lazer focused on crafting scalable, high-performing commerce experiences across the Shopify ecosystem. We partner with forward-thinking brands and agencies to design and implement custom storefronts, headless architectures, and robust backend integrations. From theme development to complex ERP and OMS workflows, our engineers bring deep expertise in Shopify, modern frameworks, and commerce infrastructure to help clients launch, scale, and optimize their digital retail experiences.


Job Summary

Lazer is seeking Technical Lead to lead the development of Shopify projects, crafting seamless user experiences and robust back-end solutions. As a Technical Lead on this team, you will support Lazer’s engineers in building products across our entire portfolio of clients and across every part of the Shopify stack (online, POS, etc.). You will work closely with key clients stakeholders, lead 2-3 projects, and have tremendous impact in supporting the engineers on the team to make sure execution is solid. You will also be a part of the strongest Shopify-focused engineering team in the market, and work closely with like-minded engineers who help each other continuously grow.

The Role

  • Lead 2-3 large commerce projects and work with the engineers on the team to ensure delivery excellence

  • Lead large commerce implementations from one commerce platforms onto Shopify (e.g. BigCommerce, Salesforce, Magento, WooCommerce migrations)

  • Lead ERP integrations (e.g. Netsuite), including familiarity with iPaaS solutions for such integrations

  • Lead CMS integrations (e.g. Sanity, Contentful, etc)

  • Understanding of the different components of the Shopify ecosystem (e.g. markets, checkout extensibility, functions, analytics, mobile, testing, etc)

  • Deep background in software and system architecture

  • Oversee Headless frontend development (e.g. React, Hydrogen, Next.js, Remix)

  • Oversee backend development (e.g. Node JS, Python, Go or Ruby preferred)

  • Knowledge of Liquid/Theme development

  • Lead OMS/WMS/IMS integrations (e.g. Manhattan)

  • Shopify app store development (i.e. building and launching apps privately for merchants or publicly on the Shopify App Store)

  • Subscriptions (e.g. Recharge, Ordergroove, Upscribe, or Shopify’s Native Subscriptions API)

  • Ensure flawless integration of third-party apps, APIs, and customizations.

Further Qualifications

  1. Problem-solving: Ability to jump into a project/product with little context and high ambiguity and identify issues, investigate causes, and propose solutions proactively.

  2. Decision-making: Confidence to make informed decisions and take action when appropriate.

  3. Communication: Skill in keeping key client stakeholders, and team members informed about problems and solutions.

  4. Consulting: Ability to consult and help clients through navigate complex technical problems and decision making.

  5. Leadership: Guide the team in best practices, set clear goals and priorities, foster collaboration.

  6. Team Orientation: Awareness of team dynamics and ability to collaborate closely across departments to implement high-impact features.

  7. Adaptability: Willingness to take on various roles and responsibilities as needed in a fast-paced startup environment.

  8. Judgment: Ability to assess situations and determine when to act independently versus when to seek guidance or collaborate.

  9. Continuous Learning: Eagerness to learn from mistakes and improve decision-making skills over time in yourself and for the project team.

  10. Resilience: Capacity to handle occasional setbacks or mistakes positively and learn from them.

  11. Proactivity: Tendency to anticipate needs and take action before being asked.

AI in our hiring process
We use AI to help us review and shortlist applications based on job-related criteria. A human hiring manager always makes the call on who moves forward. As a company that builds with AI every day, we're all for candidates using it too — just be upfront about how it helped.

  • 💥 Maximum Impact: Shape the future of the tech industry by helping ambitious projects reach their potential.

  • 🏅 True Ownership: Everyone ships code and has real autonomy with minimal meetings.

  • 💡 Continuous Learning: Be part of a team of senior engineers and designers who love learning and knowledge sharing.

Why This Might Not Be For You

  • 🤖 You Resist Modern Tools: We leverage AI and cutting-edge technology to build rapidly and focus our energy on solving the most complex, high-impact challenges for our clients.

  • 🏗️ You Crave High Structure: We thrive in an autonomous, fast-moving environment, which means you need to be comfortable with some ambiguity.

  • 😴 You Prefer Conventional Careers: Our consulting approach involves varied projects and direct client interaction — it's not for everyone.

  • 1️⃣ You Like Staying in One Lane: Our projects require adapting to different tech stacks and modern tooling quickly.

Benefits & Perks

  • 🌐 Work From Anywhere: Choose your workspace — all you need is strong wifi and a passion for building!

  • 🧘‍♂️ Work / Life Balance: We believe in our team’s ability to have it all; a great career, and time to unplug and live…you know...life.

Lazer is seeking a hands-on Controller to own the day-to-day accounting function and strengthen the financial systems that support our growth. Reporting to the CFO and partnering closely with our Finance Manager, you will own and execute the close, financial reporting, cash management, audit, tax, and compliance work. This is a working Controller role in a lean team, not an oversight-only position.

You will also improve how finance operates. You will simplify processes, introduce practical automation and AI, strengthen project and margin reporting, and give leaders clear information they can use. The right person combines strong accounting judgment with the initiative to challenge assumptions, fix gaps, and build systems that scale without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.

 

Who You Are:

Professional Experience

  • CPA designation with at least seven years of progressive accounting and finance experience.

  • Experience owning the close and financial reporting as a Controller, Assistant Controller, Senior Accounting Manager, or equivalent role.

  • A track record of working hands-on in a lean finance team, ideally within a startup, scale-up, technology, consulting, or professional services business.

  • Strong technical accounting judgment and experience with audit, tax, controls, and multi-entity reporting.

Operating and Commercial Skills

  • Experience with project or contract-based revenue, including time-and-materials, fixed-fee, or retainer engagements, and an understanding of how delivery decisions affect margin, cash, and revenue recognition.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to move from transaction detail to clear business recommendations.

  • Comfort operating in an environment where processes are still evolving and the answer is not always documented.

  • Sound judgment, high ownership, and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders constructively.


Systems and Communication

  • Demonstrated experience improving finance systems, close processes, reporting, or data quality, supported by strong spreadsheet skills and experience with Xero or a comparable cloud accounting platform.

  • Practical examples of using automation or AI to make finance work faster, more reliable, or more useful.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain accounting issues to non-finance colleagues.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively in a remote-first organization.


Additional Experience

  • Experience in a Canadian company with operations, customers, or team members in the United States is an asset.

  • Experience implementing or optimizing an ERP, close management platform, reporting tool, or finance workflow is an asset.

  • Experience supporting financing, acquisitions, diligence, or investor reporting is an asset.


What You'll Do:

Accounting and Close

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and year-end close across Lazer entities, including journal entries, reconciliations, consolidations, and supporting schedules.

  • Prepare accurate and timely financial statements, management reporting, and variance analysis.

  • Maintain clear accounting policies and working papers that support consistent treatment and a clean audit trail.

  • Stay close to the details and complete or review the work directly when needed.


Revenue and Business Performance

  • Own the accounting for time-and-materials, fixed-fee, and retainer engagements, including work in progress, unbilled revenue, deferred revenue, and the related revenue recognition judgments.

  • Run regular project reviews with delivery leaders to improve reporting on revenue, cost, margin, utilization, and labour economics, and identify budget overruns, change orders, and billing gaps early.

  • Support forecasting, scenario analysis, pricing decisions, and other work that connects financial results to business performance.

  • Review client contracts and statements of work with commercial and delivery teams for revenue recognition, billing terms and collectibility.


Finance Operations and Compliance

  • Oversee cash management, banking, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payroll, while standardizing invoicing and collections for project-based work.

  • Lead the annual audit and act as the primary contact for auditors, tax advisors, banks, and other finance partners.

  • Coordinate Canadian tax and compliance requirements, including GST and HST, year-end filings, SR&ED support where applicable, and cross-border or multi-entity requirements.

  • Maintain appropriate controls for a growing, remote company while keeping processes practical and efficient.


Systems and Automation

  • Assess the current finance stack and prioritize the improvements with the greatest operational impact.

  • Automate reconciliations, close tasks, reporting, and recurring workflows where doing so improves speed and accuracy.

  • Use AI responsibly to reduce manual work and improve analysis, documentation, and decision support.

  • Build reliable data flows between finance, delivery, sales, and people systems.


Partnership and Leadership

  • Work directly with the CFO and Finance Manager as a senior member of a small, collaborative team.

  • Translate financial results into clear recommendations for leaders across the business.

  • Ask hard questions, challenge weak assumptions, and follow issues through to resolution.

  • Help define the finance team, systems, and operating model Lazer will need at its next stage of growth.

  • 🏗️ You Crave High Structure: We thrive in an autonomous, fast-moving environment, which means you need to be comfortable with some ambiguity.

Lazer is seeking a hands-on Controller to own the day-to-day accounting function and strengthen the financial systems that support our growth. Reporting to the CFO and partnering closely with our Finance Manager, you will own and execute the close, financial reporting, cash management, audit, tax, and compliance work. This is a working Controller role in a lean team, not an oversight-only position.

You will also improve how finance operates. You will simplify processes, introduce practical automation and AI, strengthen project and margin reporting, and give leaders clear information they can use. The right person combines strong accounting judgment with the initiative to challenge assumptions, fix gaps, and build systems that scale without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.

 


WHO YOU ARE:




PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

 - CPA designation with at least seven years of progressive accounting and finance experience.

 - Experience owning the close and financial reporting as a Controller, Assistant Controller, Senior Accounting Manager, or equivalent role.

 - A track record of working hands-on in a lean finance team, ideally within a startup, scale-up, technology, consulting, or professional services business.

 - Strong technical accounting judgment and experience with audit, tax, controls, and multi-entity reporting.




OPERATING AND COMMERCIAL SKILLS

 - Experience with project or contract-based revenue, including time-and-materials, fixed-fee, or retainer engagements, and an understanding of how delivery decisions affect margin, cash, and revenue recognition.

 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to move from transaction detail to clear business recommendations.

 - Comfort operating in an environment where processes are still evolving and the answer is not always documented.

 - Sound judgment, high ownership, and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders constructively.



SYSTEMS AND COMMUNICATION

 - Demonstrated experience improving finance systems, close processes, reporting, or data quality, supported by strong spreadsheet skills and experience with Xero or a comparable cloud accounting platform.

 - Practical examples of using automation or AI to make finance work faster, more reliable, or more useful.

 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain accounting issues to non-finance colleagues.

 - Ability to collaborate effectively in a remote-first organization.



ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE

 - Experience in a Canadian company with operations, customers, or team members in the United States is an asset.

 - Experience implementing or optimizing an ERP, close management platform, reporting tool, or finance workflow is an asset.

 - Experience supporting financing, acquisitions, diligence, or investor reporting is an asset.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:




ACCOUNTING AND CLOSE

 - Own the monthly, quarterly, and year-end close across Lazer entities, including journal entries, reconciliations, consolidations, and supporting schedules.

 - Prepare accurate and timely financial statements, management reporting, and variance analysis.

 - Maintain clear accounting policies and working papers that support consistent treatment and a clean audit trail.

 - Stay close to the details and complete or review the work directly when needed.



REVENUE AND BUSINESS PERFORMANCE

 - Own the accounting for time-and-materials, fixed-fee, and retainer engagements, including work in progress, unbilled revenue, deferred revenue, and the related revenue recognition judgments.

 - Run regular project reviews with delivery leaders to improve reporting on revenue, cost, margin, utilization, and labour economics, and identify budget overruns, change orders, and billing gaps early.

 - Support forecasting, scenario analysis, pricing decisions, and other work that connects financial results to business performance.

 - Review client contracts and statements of work with commercial and delivery teams for revenue recognition, billing terms and collectibility. 


 
FINANCE OPERATIONS AND COMPLIANCE

 - Oversee cash management, banking, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payroll, while standardizing invoicing and collections for project-based work.

 - Lead the annual audit and act as the primary contact for auditors, tax advisors, banks, and other finance partners.

 - Coordinate Canadian tax and compliance requirements, including GST and HST, year-end filings, SR&ED support where applicable, and cross-border or multi-entity requirements.

 - Maintain appropriate controls for a growing, remote company while keeping processes practical and efficient.



SYSTEMS AND AUTOMATION

 - Assess the current finance stack and prioritize the improvements with the greatest operational impact.

 - Automate reconciliations, close tasks, reporting, and recurring workflows where doing so improves speed and accuracy.

 - Use AI responsibly to reduce manual work and improve analysis, documentation, and decision support.

 - Build reliable data flows between finance, delivery, sales, and people systems.



PARTNERSHIP AND LEADERSHIP

 - Work directly with the CFO and Finance Manager as a senior member of a small, collaborative team.

 - Translate financial results into clear recommendations for leaders across the business.

 - Ask hard questions, challenge weak assumptions, and follow issues through to resolution.

 - Help define the finance team, systems, and operating model Lazer will need at its next stage of growth.
